description: This file sets up server-side rendering logic for a Remix app, handling HTTP requests by detecting user agent type, managing response headers, and streaming HTML content rendered with React. It defines request handlers, imports necessary modules, and manages server-side streaming responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main export function that processes incoming HTTP requests, sets CORS headers, and dispatches to bot or browser request handlers based on user-agent detection.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server rendering for bot user-agents, streaming a rendered React component with error handling, and returning the response as a stream.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server rendering for browser user-agents, streaming the React component similarly to handleBotRequest, but tailored for browser requests.
